Part A:
We want to find the number of integers $n \in [1, 5000]$ divisible by at least one of 4, 6, 9, but not by 13.
Let $S$ be the set of multiples of 4, 6, or 9 up to 5000.
$|S| = \lfloor 5000/4 \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/6 \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/9 \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/\text{lcm}(4,6) \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/\text{lcm}(4,9) \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/\text{lcm}(6,9) \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/\text{lcm}(4,6,9) \rfloor$
$\text{lcm}(4,6) = 12$
$\text{lcm}(4,9) = 36$
$\text{lcm}(6,9) = 18$
$\text{lcm}(4,6,9) = 36$
$|S| = \lfloor 5000/4 \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/6 \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/9 \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/12 \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/36 \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/18 \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/36 \rfloor$
$|S| = 1250 + 833 + 555 - 416 - 138 - 277 + 138 = 1250 + 833 + 555 - 416 - 277 = 1945$.

Now, count elements in $S$ that are also multiples of 13:
This is the number of integers up to 5000 divisible by $\text{lcm}(k, 13)$ for $k \in \{4, 6, 9\}$.
Since $\gcd(k, 13) = 1$:
$|S \cap 13\mathbb{Z}| = \lfloor 5000/52 \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/78 \rfloor + \lfloor 5000/117 \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/156 \rfloor - \lfloor 5000/234 \rfloor$
$\lfloor 5000/52 \rfloor = 96$
$\lfloor 5000/78 \rfloor = 64$
$\lfloor 5000/117 \rfloor = 42$
$\lfloor 5000/156 \rfloor = 32$
$\lfloor 5000/234 \rfloor = 21$
$|S \cap 13\mathbb{Z}| = 96 + 64 + 42 - 32 - 21 = 149$.

So the number of integers is $1945 - 149 = 1796$.

Part C:
Integers from 296 to 12,393 inclusive divisible by 7:
First multiple of 7 $\ge 296$: $296 / 7 = 42.28... \implies 43 \times 7 = 301$.
Last multiple of 7 $\le 12393$: $12393 / 7 = 1770.42... \implies 1770 \times 7 = 12390$.
Sum of multiples of 7:
$7 \times \sum_{k=43}^{1770} k = 7 \times \frac{(43 + 1770)(1770 - 43 + 1)}{2} = 7 \times \frac{1813 \times 1728}{2} = 7 \times 1813 \times 864 = 10,964,988$.

Integers from 296 to 12,393 inclusive divisible by $\text{lcm}(7, 4) = 28$:
First multiple of 28 $\ge 296$: $296 / 28 = 10.57... \implies 11 \times 28 = 308$.
Last multiple of 28 $\le 12393$: $12393 / 28 = 442.6... \implies 442 \times 28 = 12376$.
Sum of multiples of 28:
$28 \times \sum_{m=11}^{442} m = 28 \times \frac{(11 + 442)(442 - 11 + 1)}{2} = 14 \times 453 \times 432 = 2,740,224$.

Sum of multiples of 7 not divisible by 4:
$10,964,988 - 2,740,224 = 8,224,764$.

FINAL: 1796; 2027-02-25; 8224764
